description: This file defines the 'tlAttachment' class, which manages attachment metadata for the TestLink project. It provides functionality for creating, reading, updating, and deleting attachment records, handling attachment properties, and interfacing with the database.

classes.name: tlAttachment
classes.description: A helper class to manage attachment metadata, storage, and database interactions within TestLink.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes an attachment object with specified properties and prepares it for database insertion.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Populates the attachment object with data retrieved from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns a legacy array of attachment metadata for external use.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Inserts or updates the attachment record in the database, including handling the file contents for storage.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the attachment record from the database.

methods.name: setID
methods.description: Sets the internal database ID of the attachment object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Class constructor, initializes attachment object, retrieving current configuration for repository and compression.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor, cleans up the object state.
